tooling.message:
feat(renovate): own building blocks update at any time, not only on Saturdays

## Intent

A change to the site frame or the site actions on main should reach every site at once, not wait for the Saturday window of the owner's defaults.

## Key changes

- The rule for @lernapps/site and the site actions in the org preset gets schedule "at any time"; the README says so.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Renovate must run in interactive mode, not silent, for the updates to arrive as pull requests.
